supports: Pro-growth policies and less regulation for small businesses
positions.quote: The state of small business in America is in crisis and we need pro-growth policies and less red tape to reinvigorate our economy.

source.title: Economy & Jobs | Representative Andrew Garbarino (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: He would vote to cut federal regulations on small businesses. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: One of my most important priorities in Congress is to restore the full State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction.

source.title: Taxes | Representative Andrew Garbarino (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: A full SALT deduction would mainly lower federal taxes for homeowners in high-tax areas like Long Island. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: I will always support our men and women in law enforcement and work to restore law and order.

source.title: Representative Andrew Garbarino (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: Expect support for federal funding for police. Day-to-day policing is run by county and village police.
